* A blacklist of failed routes to avoid when creating a new connection to a
 * target address. This is used so that OkHttp can learn from its mistakes: if
 * there was a failure attempting to connect to a specific IP address or proxy
 * server, that failure is remembered and alternate routes are preferred.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public synchronized void failed(Route failedRoute)
methods.comment: Records a failure connecting to {@code failedRoute}.

methods.name: public synchronized boolean shouldPostpone(Route route)
methods.comment: Returns true if {@code route} has failed recently and should be avoided.
